plan.html: • A function takes a String by value. After the call, which binding owns the string?

criteria.description: Identifies the parameter as the owner after the move.

rubric.full: The function's parameter owns the String after it is moved into the function.
rubric.partial: A moved value has one current owner; the caller's binding no longer owns it.

plan.html: • A Rust block creates a String named note and then reaches its closing brace. Explain what ownership implies for note when the block ends.

criteria.description: States that note is the owner of the String.
States that the String is released when note's block scope ends.

rubric.expected: note owns the String, and it is dropped when note's block scope ends.
rubric.full: Explain that note owns the String and that its value is dropped when the block scope ends.
rubric.partial: Credit requires identifying note as the owner and connecting release to the end of its scope.
